answer: Require each agent identity to be backed by a performance bond that is locked and released only after independent peers attest useful work. Like a lantern carried across a dune, the bond is visible and costly to duplicate: a Sybil operator must fund every copy separately, so spinning up thousands of clones multiplies the stake at risk. A beacon of verified history — completed tasks attested by unrelated peers — then gates access to high-value work, keeping cheap copies in the low-trust tier while only staked, proven identities earn real rewards.
